build_lid_predictor_from_model: build a language ID predictor from a FastText model file with optional confidence thresholds
build_lid_predictor_from_date: build a language ID predictor using a model date string to auto-resolve model and threshold files
run_lid_prediction: run language identification on a sentence and return the predicted language label and confidence score
test_lid_predictor_thresholds: test the language ID predictor with per-label confidence thresholds to filter low-confidence predictions
review_predict_lid_closure: review the predict_lid closure function that applies threshold logic and returns language label with probability
